content.comment_body: I need to read two analog inputs and route the higher one to an analog output. The selection should occur when the difference between inputs exceeds 5%. Which function block should be used? Thanks.
Hello, You can use an analog multiplexer for switching to the output and an analog comparator to identify the difference. I've attached a file to help you get started. Regards,
Thanks, that's very helpful. I modified the original version by reducing the hysteresis to 1%. The result works well. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked about comparing two analog inputs and outputting the higher value when their difference exceeds a set threshold, and wanted suggestions for suitable function blocks. Experienced responses recommended using analog multiplexer and comparator blocks, which resolved the issue quickly. The thread shows that using functional blocks for signal comparison and customizing parameters like hysteresis can be straightforward.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects simple function blocks for analog signal comparison and switching, as well as flexibility to easily adjust settings such as hysteresis.
